summary: [BE] LAMOS LOS SME - Bucket Agunan - Data Agunan > Add Agunan/Collaterals Part 2
description:
User Story
 : 
As an 
Account Officer (AO)
, I want the system to check for existing collateral records when I add a new one, 
so that I can choose
 between 
reusing an existing record
 or 
creating a new one
 to prevent duplicate entries.
Scope 
: 
- Step Form Penambahan Data Agunan
- Definition of Jenis Agunan by CLS
- Form based of Jenis Agunan by CLS
- Save to Draft
- Simpan
Flow 
: 
Acceptance Criteria
 : 
Requirement
Acceptance Criteria
Mockup
Max Entry
Max entry is X Data Agunan
IF 
all entry agunan data has reached X data agunan, and user wants to click add 
THEN 
System Will show pop up “Maximum number agunan has been reached, plase ask 
administrator 
to remove from current data agunan”
X is parameterize, currently will be set at 100
Step of entry data agunan
Given 
the Account Officer has selected either "New Collateral" or "Existing Collateral from CLS” 
When User selected one method Then
 system displays the 5-step Collateral Data Entry Form:
- Pengisian Form Informasi Umum Agunan
- Form Data Tambahan Agunan
- Pengisian terkait Form Informasi Kepemilikan Agunan
With default entry will show 
Form Informasi Umum Agunan
Data Entry
Given 
Account Officer in step of entry data agunan 
When 
open new form to tambah agunan 
Then 
Data point will show based 

 

 
Step Form Informasi Umum Agunan
When 
User Klik side navigation form indicator on the left bar at “Informasi Umum Agunan” 
Then System 
will load new form based on 
Data Point Step Informasi Umum Agunan

 

 
Step Form Data Tambahan Agunan
When 
User Klik side navigation form indicator on the left bar at “Data Tambahan Agunan” 
Then System 
will load new form based on 
Data Point Step Data Tambahan Agunan

 
Step Form Informasi Kepemilikan
- When Bucket Identity is Lengkap (ada ceklist button di sebelah label Bucket)
When 
User Klik side navigation form indicator on the left bar at “Informasi Kepemilikan” and 
'Bucket Identity and Pengecekan' 
is Complete 
Then System 
will load new form based on 
Data Point Step Informasi Kepemilikan

 

 
Step Form Informasi Kepemilikan
- When Bucket Identity is Tidak Lengkap
When 
User Klik side navigation form indicator on the left bar at “Informasi Kepemilikan” and 
'Bucket Identity and Pengecekan'
 is not Locked 
Then 
System will show dialog that user cannot continue to progress untill Bucket Identity dan Pengecekan is Completed
Paralel Form
When 
the Account Officer clicks on any specific form label on the left panel of the pop-up modal 
Then 
the system must redirect the user directly to the selected form step immediately And the system must not restrict the order of form completion based on the step sequence
Indicators Form
When 
the Account Officer completes all mandatory fields within a form, 
then 
the side navigation form indicator on the left must change its status to 'Lengkap'.
Contoh Apabila Form Informasi Umum Agunan dan Distribusi Agunan Sudah Lengkap (Semua Field Mandatory Terpenuhi) : 
When Indicator Sudah 'Lengkap' User tetap bisa melakukan edit data 
Given 
the Account Officer completes all mandatory fields within a form, 
And 
the side navigation form indicator on the left must change its status to 'Lengkap', 
When 
User Click at Form or by Click Tab Banner Then Form will still can be openned and user still can change the value in thats form
Save to Draft
Given 
the Account Officer is on any step of the 3-step Collateral Data Entry Form And the Account Officer has partially filled in the required data fields 
When 
the Account Officer clicks the "Save as Draft" button 
Then 
the system 
must not validate
 and temporarily store the current inputted data And the system must show a success notification "Draft Saved Successfully" And the system must allow the user to close or exit the modal without losing the saved progress
Button “
Simpan
”
Given 
the Account Officer is on the 
When 
all of the 3-step Collateral Data Entry Form And there are one or more mandatory fields left blank across any of the steps 
Then 
button “
Simpan
” will show up / enable to click
From 
To 
Fail to submit final due to wrong format of the fields
Given 
the Account Officer is on the final step of the 3-step Collateral Data Entry Form And there are one or more mandatory fields left blank across any of the steps 
When 
the Account Officer clicks the "Simpan" button 
Then 
the system must block the submission process And the system must display an error notification specifying which fields are wrong And the system must show information wich form are  incorrect / incomplete
Successfully submit final when all data is complete
Given 
the Account Officer is on the final step of the 3-step Collateral Data Entry Form And all mandatory fields across all 3 steps have been fully and correctly filled 
When 
the Account Officer clicks the "Simpan" button 
Then 
the system must successfully process and save the collateral data And the system must display a success notification stating "Penginputan data agunan sudah sesuai" (Collateral data entry is complete and valid) And the system must close the pop-up modal and refresh the Collateral Summary page
